# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.2.50 - 2026-11-04

- First version in this marketplace: the Azure skills, copied from https://github.com/microsoft/azure-skills at commit `5b4f0c0`.
- Skill files are unchanged from the vendor's.
- The vendor's plugin-level files (manifests, MCP configs, hooks, commands, docs, build files) are not included. BoldCreate Connect delivers only skills, agents, rules and hooks, and the hooks it delivers must use Cursor's `hooks/hooks.json` format.
- The vendor's hooks (Claude, Copilot and Cursor variants) are not included.
- The vendor's `assets/` folder holds screenshots, so it is not used for the logo.
